question: Should this issue be resolved by a sessions.list-backed dashboard builtin in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826, or should the widget wait for the broader sessions.activity contract in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/39127?
rationale: The UI request is coherent, but maintainers must choose whether coarse current session rows are sufficient for the first dashboard widget or whether task/progress/attention semantics must be accepted first.

options.title: Review staged dashboard builtin
options.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the implementation candidate, while requiring its blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

options.title: Wait for activity API
options.body: Keep this issue open until the richer sessions.activity gateway contract lands, then build the widget against that stable source.

options.title: Fold into roadmap tracker
options.body: Move sequencing to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/101136 only after preserving this issue's unique agent-status acceptance details there.

recommendation.title: Review staged dashboard builtin
recommendation.body: Treat https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101826 as the implementation candidate, while requiring its blockers and proof to clear before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history across the Control UI session surface, gateway sessions methods, and plugin-tab seam involved in the decision.
